en.headline: Police investigate five dogs found dead near San Tin fishponds as possible animal cruelty
en.dek: Officers were called around 11.35am on Sunday after animal volunteers reported four black dogs dumped beside a rubbish heap, with a fifth carcass found nearby.
body: Police are investigating the discovery of five dead dogs near fishponds in San Tin, Yuen Long, on Sunday morning as a possible case of animal cruelty.

A report was received at about 11.35am that four dog carcasses had been found beside a rubbish heap next to a fishpond at Hop Shing Wai. Officers later located a fifth carcass at another nearby pond. All five were local dogs; one of the first four was microchipped.

The Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals was notified. The case has been listed as discovery of animal remains and is being handled by the Border District crime unit. No one has been arrested.

zh.headline: 新田魚塘旁發現五隻唐狗屍體 警方列作殘酷對待動物調查
zh.dek: 今早約11時35分動物義工報案，四隻黑狗棄於垃圾堆，附近再發現第五隻。
body: 元朗新田合盛圍一帶魚塘旁今早發現五隻唐狗屍體，警方正以殘酷對待動物方向調查。
警方指上午約11時35分接獲義工報案，四隻黑狗被棄置於魚塘旁垃圾堆，屍體交錯重疊。其後在附近另一魚塘再發現一隻。其中一隻植有晶片。
愛護動物協會已派員到場。案件暫列「發現動物屍體」，由邊界警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
